verdict.rationale: Forter is an API-driven SaaS platform with an official MCP server that lets AI systems take real actions, so scoped agent credentials are a fair question. However, no evidence shows Forter issuing scoped, least-privilege, or per-agent API keys or permissions. The Shopify item is a token the merchant gives to Forter, and the production/sandbox split is an adjacent environment feature, not credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
